records.summary: In its 2020 annual report, Palestine's Financial and Administrative Control Bureau qualified its audit of the Ministry of Finance's consolidated closing account. One finding was that the ministry had not disclosed an amount of 2,130,918 dinars that it owed to the Palestine Monetary Authority. The finding is against the ministry's disclosure; the Monetary Authority is the creditor.

records.summary: In the Central Bank of Uzbekistan's own 2025 anti-corruption report (Appendix 11), the bank states that disciplinary measures were applied to 10 of its employees over shortcomings found in its 2025 monitoring. The same report says three procurement counterparties were found to be affiliated with each other and their procurement processes were cancelled, and that two existing conflicts of interest among 2,152 declaring managers were resolved.

records.summary: Two 2004 internal audits of the Bank of Canada, released under the Access to Information Act, criticised the bank for slack financial practices. The audits found that employees of the central bank paid invoices without authorization, did not evaluate whether they got good value from suppliers, and violated a fail-safe system meant to guard against cheque fraud. One of the reports is dated 15 October.
records.source_title: Audit scolds Bank of Canada (Central Banking)
records.quote: Employees of the central bank paid invoices without authorization
